statements:
CREATE TEMP TABLE g2a ON COMMIT DROP AS WITH us AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.entity_id sid, p.source_id FROM legal_text_provenance p WHERE p.source='uqn' AND p.entity_type='system'),
t AS (SELECT us.*, s.name FROM us JOIN legal_systems s ON s.id=us.sid
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_articles z WHERE z."legalSystemId"=us.sid AND coalesce(z.chapter,'')<>'')
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM us u2 WHERE u2.sid=us.sid)=1
    AND s.name !~ '(حقوق المؤلف|الإحصاء|الخطوط الحديدية|الأسماء التجارية|السجل التجاري|الاستثمار الأجنبي)' AND s.name <> ALL (ARRAY[$hk$ضوابط المنشآت الواقعة بأسواق النفع العام للخضار والفواكه واللحوم والبيض والأسماك$hk$])
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM uqn_stage.unit u WHERE u.source_id=us.source_id AND u.unit_type='article' AND u.body ~ '(^|\n)\s*(الباب|الفصل|القسم|الجزء|الفرع)\s+\S+')),
un AS (SELECT u.source_id, u.number, count(*) c FROM uqn_stage.unit u JOIN t ON t.source_id=u.source_id WHERE u.unit_type='article' AND u.number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2),
c AS (SELECT a.id tid, t.sid, t.source_id, u.seq,
   btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CASE WHEN coalesce(u.chapter,'')<>'' AND coalesce(u.section,'')<>'' THEN u.chapter||' › '||u.section ELSE coalesce(nullif(u.chapter,''),u.section,'') END, '\s*\n\s*', ' — ', 'g'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) heading,
   uqn_fix.hkm30_norm(regexp_replace(u.body, '(\s*(تنزيل الملف|تم نسخ الرابط))*\s*جميع الحقوق محفوظة لجريدة أم القرى © \d{4}\s*$', '')) ub, uqn_fix.hkm30_norm(a.content) ac, uqn_fix.hkm30_norm(coalesce(a.title||' ','')||a.content) atc
 FROM t JOIN legal_articles a ON a."legalSystemId"=t.sid AND a."articleBis"=0 AND coalesce(a.chapter,'')=''
 JOIN uqn_stage.unit u ON u.source_id=t.source_id AND u.unit_type='article' AND u.number=a."articleNumber"
 JOIN un ON un.source_id=u.source_id AND un.number=u.number AND un.c=1)
SELECT tid, sid, source_id, seq, heading FROM c
WHERE (ub=ac OR ub=atc OR greatest(similarity(ub,ac),similarity(ub,atc))>=0.9)
  AND heading ~ '^(الباب|الفصل|القسم|الجزء|الفرع)\s' AND length(heading) BETWEEN 3 AND 200 AND heading !~ 'المادة' AND heading !~ '[*#_|<>]'
  AND length(regexp_replace(heading,'[^(]','','g'))=length(regexp_replace(heading,'[^)]','','g'))

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM g2a)=1570 AND (SELECT md5(string_agg(tid||'|'||heading, '|' ORDER BY tid)) FROM g2a)='3942979e59d82ca30b4ae6163a487de3' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM g2a h JOIN legal_articles a ON a.id=h.tid WHERE coalesce(a.chapter,'')<>'')=0 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_text_provenance WHERE source_id='gap002a-uqn-chapters-2026-10-28')=0 THEN 'ok' ELSE (1/(SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE false))::text END AS guard_before

INSERT INTO legal_text_provenance (id, entity_type, entity_id, law_name, article_number, source, source_id, source_url, text_sha, retrieved_on, action, previous_text, created_at) SELECT 'g2ap-'||left(encode(sha256(convert_to('gap002a-uqn-chapters-2026-10-28|'||h.tid,'UTF8')),'hex'),24), 'article', h.tid, a."lawName", a."articleNumber", 'uqn', 'gap002a-uqn-chapters-2026-10-28', 'https://www.uqn.gov.sa/details?p='||replace(h.source_id,'uqn:','')||'#unit-'||h.seq, encode(sha256(convert_to(h.heading,'UTF8')),'hex'), '2026-10-28'::date, 'chapter_set:uqn_unit', coalesce(a.chapter,''), now() FROM g2a h JOIN legal_articles a ON a.id=h.tid
UPDATE legal_articles a SET chapter = h.heading, "updatedAt" = now() FROM g2a h WHERE a.id = h.tid AND coalesce(a.chapter,'')=''

UPDATE legal_articles a SET search_norm = uqn_fix.hkm30_search_norm(a."lawName", a.title, a.content, a.keywords, a.classification, a.chapter) FROM g2a h WHERE a.id = h.tid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unit_version v WHERE v.unit_id = a.id AND v.valid_from <= now())

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles a JOIN g2a h ON h.tid=a.id WHERE a.chapter=h.heading)=1570 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_text_provenance WHERE source_id='gap002a-uqn-chapters-2026-10-28')=1570 THEN 'ok' ELSE (1/(SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE false))::text END AS guard_after
